focus: D1 Correctness - the doctor MCP route, its doctor script and its install/debug workflows against the post-decommission tree

findingDetails.title: MCP install workflow for the advisor cannot succeed, and carries a keyless orphan server block
findingDetails.evidence: install_steps and fallback_build cd into {skill_dir}/mcp-server, which does not exist (renamed to runtime/); lines 118-129 nest a keyless 'System Code Graph' block that repeats the advisor entry's keys and points at mcp-server/dist/index.js, a path that exists in no skill directory.
findingDetails.recommendation: Repoint install_steps/fallback_build at {skill_dir}/runtime, and either restore the orphan block under its own server key or delete it.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Full servers block read (lines 99-146); sibling debug workflow confirmed rewritten to runtime/; no exempting decision found in the packet residue record.

findingDetails.title: Live doctor script still presents the advisor as an MCP server and permanently reports it unwired
findingDetails.evidence: Help text reads 'system_skill_advisor  Skill Advisor (Node.js MCP, advisor_recommend + skill_graph_*)'; detect_and_check_configs() iterates servers=(system_skill_advisor code_mode) over opencode.json, .claude/mcp.json and .vscode/mcp.json, none of which declare the advisor, so every run warns 'Not wired'. Stale strings at :300, :303, :360, :399 still say mcp-server.
findingDetails.recommendation: Drop the advisor from the config-wiring server set (or assert the inverted contract), and rewrite the help text plus the mcp-server log strings.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All five runtime configs grepped for any advisor declaration (zero hits); FILTER_SERVER checked to confirm it cannot remove system_skill_advisor from the default set.

findingDetails.title: MCP debug workflow still enumerates the advisor as a supported MCP server
findingDetails.evidence: Header comment says 'supported servers (skill-advisor, code-mode)' and both install_guides and the server map bind system_skill_advisor to the advisor's INSTALL-GUIDE.md as an MCP install guide.
findingDetails.recommendation: Remove the advisor from the MCP server enumeration, or label it as a daemon health-check target rather than a server.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Same file's repair_actions (:110-122) already use runtime/ paths, which classifies the hit as drift rather than a decision; advisor INSTALL-GUIDE.md verified transport-free.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Live operator command family governing transport registration claims across three workflow assets.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The only live surface whose stated job is to report the advisor's transport registration; highest blast radius for a surviving MCP claim.

searchLedger.invariant: Every command a live workflow prints must resolve from the final tree

searchActions.result: three hits at :114,:115,:116 inside the advisor server entry
health checks use runtime/, install steps use mcp-server/, plus a keyless second server block

searchLedger.rationale: Two independent defects in one entry: a dead install path and an unkeyed duplicate server block.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A diagnostic that scans for a removed registration will report it as missing on every run

searchActions.result: detect_and_check_configs() runs unconditionally with servers=(system_skill_advisor code_mode) and record_warn on absence
no output, exit 1 - confirmation the warn branch is the permanent state

searchLedger.rationale: The check's success branch is unreachable by construction.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Sibling workflow still claims server membership

searchActions.result: membership claims at :27,:42,:90; repair actions already renamed at :110-122

searchLedger.rationale: Membership claim survives while the repair paths were migrated, so the defect is documentation-level.

searchLedger.invariant: Advisor package docs describe the shipped transport

searchActions.result: 3 hits, all negative statements ('no MCP registration step', 'no MCP transport to fall back to')

searchLedger.rationale: Only negative statements remain, which is the correct post-decommission voice.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The advisor package's own transport documentation is clean.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The command doc itself may inherit the MCP-server framing

searchActions.result: describes MCP-server assessment generically and names both workflows; no advisor-specific MCP claim

searchLedger.rationale: Fix wording at the workflow level (F001-F003) before touching the command doc's generic framing; re-check in the replay pass.
searchLedger.deferredReason: Generic MCP framing is correct for the remaining registered servers (code_mode); only the advisor-specific rows are wrong.

results.summary: The packet's normative claim that no surface still declares the advisor an MCP server does not hold on the doctor command family; other class-3 surfaces not yet swept.
Target packet holds no checklist.md (Level 1 scaffold); no checked completion claims exist to verify yet.
